items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And when I met him in Las Vegas, it was almost like meeting a total stranger

ctx.x: He had a kid playing guitar, and I can't think of his name because he only lasted about two or three days, that weekend, whatever, because he was so far out on pills and things... And then Red brought in Lloyd Ellis, he was a guitar player. After just a few days, Lloyd Ellis came in.

And when I met him in Las Vegas, it was almost like meeting a total stranger, meeting Red in terms of here we are and looking over the gig. I always respected him; I had so much respect for Red as a musician. That's the only way I knew of him, his music. And I was happy to be associated with him, and
